title: Single DB Pool for Fast & Slow Queries
pattern: Sharing a single database connection pool between fast online user requests and slow, analytical background transactions.
why_bad: Slow, long-running database transactions check out all connections from the pool and hold them. Fast requests block indefinitely waiting for a connection, causing catastrophic user-facing latency.
detection: Slow and fast database transactions executing against the same global connection pool instance.
counterexample: Separate, dedicated pools for OLTP (Online Transaction Processing) and OLAP (Online Analytical Processing) queries.
fix: Create two separate pools: one small pool with short timeouts for fast user-facing transactions, and a separate pool with a low connection count for slow, background batch reporting.
